summary: Remove all .pak files after the folder loader passes
author: pm
body:
Remove every `.pak` under `staged/` and `tools/display_id_manager/sprites/` with `git rm` (part of HH-0055). Do this only after the folder loader passes the in-game check and the pak_extract `--verify` comes back clean. Then run deploy `--dry-run` to confirm the old paks leave `game/client/sprites`.

**Done when:** no `.pak` is tracked, deploy removes the deployed copies, and the game runs.

Source: user, 2026-11-24: "Fix the client and remove the pak files".

comments.author: client
comments.body:
Pak removal done (uncommitted, staged in the index).

- Pre-delete proof: `pak_extract.py --verify` -> 361 of 361 byte-identical, 0 failed.
- Tracked paks: 361 (264 `staged/`, 97 `tools/display_id_manager/sprites/`), none outside. Removed with Mode 2 script `.claude/scratch/pak_rm/pak_rm.py` (dry-run 361; verify 361 checked, 0 failed: each path tracked, `.pak`, in-tree, sibling `manifest.json` tracked with matching source, size and sha256); applied `git rm` in chunks of 40 on the explicit list. `git ls-files "*.pak"` is now empty.
- `git rm` of `.claude/tools/scripts/pak_extract.py` and `fetch_korea_2024.py`.
- Deploy (`deploy.py --target all --config Debug`): dry-run then real run; removed all 264 deployed paks from `game/client/sprites/` (deploy manifest owned them), added 2 new staged files (`sprites/panelkit/panel_kit.json`, `.png`), server unchanged. 0 `.pak` left in `game/`. Runtime state untouched.
- Not done here: no build, no in-game run after the deploy, no commit, no doc edits. Residue mentions (comments/docstrings, one doc line) reported to the PM.
